meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of federal civil case filings from court records, kept for research and marketing planning. A filing says where a plaintiff lives and what kind of case was brought, not that a claim has merit, that a lawyer was hired or how a case ended. County means the county of residence of the first-listed plaintiff (the first-listed defendant's county when the United States sues; the tract's county in land condemnation cases), as the Federal Judicial Center codes it; the court also has codes for a plaintiff who lives in the U.S. outside the court's state and for one who lives abroad. Rights and deadlines in a matter are for your own counsel.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.
